project_type: Full-stack app: Python/FastAPI backend, React/Vite frontend, Cloudflare Workers edge
build_system: pnpm workspaces with pnpm-workspace.yaml, pip-compile for Python
build_command: pnpm install && pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @workspace/syrabit exec tsc --noEmit
verification_instructions: 1. Run edge tests: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge test. 2. Type-check edge: pnpm --filter syrabit-edge exec tsc --noEmit. 3. Verify Python syntax with: python -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open("apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py").read())' etc.
setup_instructions: 1. nvm use 22. 2. corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.26.1 --activate. 3. pnpm install. 4. pyenv shell 3.11.15 for backend Python.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.11.15 via pyenv. Node.js 22 via nvm. Cannot run full backend tests without MongoDB/Redis services, but can validate syntax and run edge/frontend tests.
contribution_requirements: No specific CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow existing patterns. Use jose->jwt migration carefully since both admin.py and auth.py import from jose.
key_patterns: Backend uses FastAPI with Pydantic settings, Upstash Redis for rate-limiting/caching, Motor/Beanie for MongoDB. Edge uses Cloudflare Workers with KV. Frontend uses React with context providers. CI uses GitHub Actions with pnpm.
directory_structure: Monorepo: apps/backend (Python/FastAPI), apps/edge (CF Workers/TS), apps/frontend (React/Vite). .github/workflows/ for CI/CD. infra/ for IaC.
